title: editable list pattern by field count
name: Editable list pattern by field count
rule: Editable-list pattern by field count — dynamic add/remove when items ≤3 and inputs need no separate titles; editable table 2–5; collapsible panel 6–8; drawer when >8.

citation.source: Ant Design — Data entry ; Ant Design — Form research

pass_when: Pattern matches the cited count band (≤3 add/remove; 2–5 table; 6–8 panel; >8 drawer).
fail_when: Drawer for ≤3, or add/remove-without-titles for >8, against those bands.
overview: Editable-list UI scales by field count from add/remove through drawer.
apply_when: Building Ant editable lists or multi-field item editors by size.
not_when: Single-field forms that are not an editable list of items.
agent_hint: Match pattern to count: ≤3 add/remove, 2–5 table, 6–8 panel, >8 drawer.
description: Ant maps editable-list patterns to field count: dynamic add/remove when items are ≤3 and inputs need no separate titles; editable table for about 2–5; collapsible panel for 6–8; drawer when more than eight. Using a drawer for tiny sets, or title-free add/remove for huge ones, breaks those bands. Choose the shell that matches the count.
do_not_claim: A house count that collapses the bands.
